style: Photograph of a real handmade needle-felted wool and sculpted polymer clay miniature, visible soft wool fibres and fine clay fingerprint texture, warm soft macro lens lighting, storybook craft toy

items.subject: A cute small woodland sprout sprite mascot with chibi proportions: a big round golden-amber head with chubby rosy cheeks, large glossy dark oval eyes with white catchlights and a tiny button nose and a small smile, wearing a glossy chestnut-brown textured acorn cap like a helmet with a short woody stem and one bright green sprout leaf curling out of its top, small cupped golden ears under the cap brim; a small pear-shaped golden-amber body with a skirt of bright green leaf petals around the waist; slender golden arms with small rounded four-fingered hands; slender short legs with rounded golden teardrop feet; a small curled green leaf tail at the back

A big hulking storybook beetle king boss monster standing upright on two short stout legs: a huge rounded glossy deep emerald-teal beetle shell covering its back and shoulders with patches of green moss and rows of crimson thorn spikes along the shell ridge, a broad dark brown segmented chitin belly with one glowing amber gem in the chest, two thick heavy arms ending in ivory claws, a broad head with two curved ivory tusks, small fierce amber eyes, and a small spiky golden crown on top of the head
A single plump ribbed golden sun seed, teardrop shaped with shallow vertical ribs and a tiny green sprout leaf at its top, glowing warm gold
A single whole shiny golden acorn, a smooth plump rounded golden nut that is complete and rounded on every side, with a textured scaly bronze cupule cap and a short stem on top
A single glossy crimson red berry shaped like a plump rounded heart, the same deep red felt colour all the way around including the back, with two small green leaves and a short brown stem on top

A storybook checkpoint post seen from the front: one carved wooden upright post standing on a small round flat grey stone base, with a short horizontal wooden crossbar arm at the top of the post sticking out to the right side only, like a small gallows for hanging a flag, the arm is empty with nothing hanging from it
A storybook round oak tree with a short thick gnarled brown trunk and a big round puffy canopy of bright green leaf clusters
A storybook fir tree, a short brown trunk and layered tiers of dark green pine boughs forming a plump cone
A single cute toadstool mushroom with a thick cream stem and a big domed glossy red cap covered in white spots
A small clump of woodland flowers: three daisy-like flowers with white and yellow petals on green stems with a few leaves
A single rounded grey boulder with patches of bright green moss on top
A single tall round carved grey stone column with a square plinth base and a carved capital, patches of green moss and ivy
A freestanding rounded stone archway seen from the front, two short stone pillars joined by a curved arch of stone blocks, covered with green moss and small flowers, the opening empty
A storybook wooden watchtower: four timber legs with cross bracing, a small lookout hut on top with a pointed red shingle roof and a small cloth pennant on a pole
A single small wooden crate made of planks with darker corner battens and iron nails
A single small wooden barrel with dark iron hoops, standing upright
A storybook garden lantern post: a curved wooden post with a hooked arm at the top from which hangs a small brass lantern with warm glowing glass panes
A cluster of five pale lavender and clear quartz crystal points growing from a small grey rock base
A low round volcanic basalt vent mound made of dark stones with glowing orange ember cracks and a hollow glowing crater on top
A single fluffy white puffy cumulus cloud made of round soft lumps with a flat underside, plain white wool all around, no face, no eyes, no mouth, no cheeks, no decoration
A single chunky five-pointed golden star ornament with a glowing warm amber centre, standing upright
A short squat round wooden drum pedestal with a copper band around it and a flat top, like the base of a bounce pad

A wide storybook portal gateway seen straight from the front: two short stocky carved mossy grey stone pillars standing far apart on square stone plinths, joined by a wide flat semicircular arch of stone blocks on top with a golden sun-ray ornament at the keystone and a little green ivy, the arch opening is very wide and tall, about twice as wide as both pillars together, completely empty so you can see straight through it

A storybook windmill tower WITHOUT sails seen from the front: a round tapering stone and timber tower with a small wooden door and windows, a pointed golden thatched roof, and one short round wooden axle hub sticking out of the front just below the roof where the sails would attach; no sails, no blades, no arms

A single windmill sail cross seen straight from the front, lying flat: four long wooden lattice sail arms with cream cloth panels arranged in an X, joined at one round wooden hub in the centre, nothing else

The body of a brown hawk bird WITHOUT any wings, the wings are completely removed, only the head with a hooked yellow beak, the streamlined brown feathered body and a fanned tail, seen from the side, flying pose with no wings
A single detached brown hawk wing lying flat and fully spread, seen from directly above, long primary feathers at the tip, rounded shoulder end, one wing only, no body

A friendly round hedgehog villager standing on four short legs, a soft cream-coloured face and belly with a pointed snout, a shiny black button nose, small dark eyes, small rounded ears, a back covered in many soft brown felted spines, and a small knitted green scarf around its neck

A charismatic glossy iridescent emerald-teal and sapphire forest rhinoceros beetle with one proud curved bronze-tipped horn on its head, a domed shell with a central seam, six short chunky segmented legs clearly separated, low to the ground
